description: This Java class defines the response to a 'ModifyResources' command within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing properties, and serialization.

classes.name: ModifyResourcesResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a ModifyResources command, with JSON serialization/deserialization, property accessors, and equality methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a response from PolicyId, Label, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with the response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the modified PolicyEntry.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resources.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the object into JSON payload.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
